The user wants UI strings for a browser app in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文). The screen: browser has a store page where users can install third-party extensions/add-ons to extend the browser.

They want:
- "s1": title of the store page
- "s2": install button
- "s3": installed/stalled complete status text

Only output a JSON object with keys s1, s2, s3, string values, no other text.

Let me write natural Traditional Chinese strings:

s1: "擴充功能商店" or "附加元件商店" — in Taiwan, browser extensions are commonly called "擴充功能" (Chrome uses 附加元件 in Taiwan? Actually Chrome Traditional Chinese uses "擴充功能"). Firefox uses "附加元件". Let's use "擴充功能商店" — a store title. Maybe include browser name? No specific name given, so generic: "擴充功能商店".

s2: "安裝" — the install button.

s3: "已安裝" — installed status. Or "安裝完成". Status text after installation completes: "已安裝" is common. The prompt says "安裝完成的狀態文字" — status text when installation is complete. "已安裝" works well as a status. Could also be "安裝完成".

I'll go with:
{
  "s1": "擴充功能商店",
  "s2": "安裝",
  "s3": "已安裝"
}

Use Traditional Chinese characters. "擴充功能" is traditional. Good.

Output only JSON, no other text. Should I format with code block? They said only output a JSON object, no other text — so plain JSON without markdown fences might be best. I'll output just the JSON.</think>{
  "s1": "擴充功能商店",
  "s2": "安裝",
  "s3": "已安裝"
}
